question: Does a new versioned branching-process kernel respect event boundaries, loss and switching rules, and reproduce tractable synthetic birth-death laws?
decision: Qualify numerical components for a later explicit observation-model comparison; do not fit the exposed England cohort or rank founder/switching hypotheses.
strongest_rival: Event-selection, boundary, founder-allocation or probability-conditioning errors can create apparent evidence for persistent founder classes.
discriminator: Branch and truncation invariant tests plus fixed-seed simulation checks against independently derived single-type moments/extinction and a common-clock piecewise law.
exposure_record: Historical England clone summaries and simulator defects were already read. These synthetic fixtures were authored for numerical qualification, not independent biological validation.
biological_unit: Not applicable to synthetic numerical qualification; any later biological comparison must use source-indexed mice and retain nested clones.
nesting_and_overlap: Simulation draws are computational replicates of one stated mathematical law, never independent biological samples. Seeds are separate numerical checks.
population_and_selection: Five fixed synthetic cases, two seeds and 6000 realizations per case/seed, all specified before execution; no England clone-size values are fitted.
contrast: Empirical synthetic mean and extinction versus exact mathematical expectations for constant or common-clock rates; equal-growth switching has the same total-size law.
endpoint: Absolute numerical deviation in mean size and extinction probability, with predeclared six-standard-error Monte Carlo tolerance.
methods: Continuous-time six-event branching process, exact regime boundary resampling, absorbing extinction and fail-closed caps; pure-birth, slow-loss, critical, piecewise and equal-growth-switching checks.
missingness_and_exclusions: No numerical cap hit is converted to a terminal size; invalid rates, boundaries, caps or output reuse fail the run. No failed case is excluded.
multiplicity: Ten numerical case/seed checks; no biological p-values or multiple-testing claims. Every check is retained and all must pass.
precision_basis: Monte Carlo tolerance is six times the analytical standard error using the known synthetic variance or binomial variance. The computational sample count is not biological sample-size justification.
interpretation_limit: Passing numerical checks does not establish parameter identifiability, observed-data likelihood accuracy, adequate mouse-level precision, source curve reproduction or persistent founder biology.
stop_rule: Stop on any invariant/test failure, numerical cap or synthetic deviation outside the frozen tolerance. Biological fitting remains on hold pending the observation and fair-comparison specification.
amendment_reason: A new preparatory numerical-qualification stage preserves all earlier scripts and outputs. It does not execute or silently replace the historical FU_S fit contract.
